questions.q: How do Texas hail and hurricane deductibles work?
questions.a: Home policies here often have a separate wind/hail or hurricane deductible, sometimes listed as a percentage of the dwelling limit. We'll explain how it applies to storms and help you choose a deductible that balances premium and out-of-pocket costs.

questions.q: Can you review my existing Texas policies?
questions.a: Absolutely. We'll check for gaps, overlaps, and Texas-specific details such as wind/hail deductibles, roof and construction credits, homestead considerations, and common discounts. We'll then recommend clear options - often with savings.

about.title: Your trusted insurance partner.
text: BIG - Brock Insurance Group was founded on a simple belief: people deserve clarity, care, and real advocacy when it comes to protecting what matters most.

From day one, we set out to be a neighbor first and an agency second - growing through trust, referrals, and the outcomes we deliver for Texas families and businesses. We have become a trusted partner in Texas.

As a Texas independent agency, we represent several leading insurance companies rather than any single provider. That gives us the ability to continually monitor the marketplace and offer you the best possible rates. Our mission is to provide you the highest level of customer service and dedicate our resources to meet your needs and earn your trust.
With four generations of Texas experience, we protect what matters most with integrity, proactive risk advice, and responsive claims support, so you can move forward with confidence.

Our Agency has helped thousands of Texas clients find the lowest rates available and the best insurance plans to protect their cars, homes, businesses, and families for decades. We serve clients all over Texas with offices in Friendswood and New Braunfels.

faqs.q: What types of insurance do you offer in Texas?
faqs.a: We offer a full lineup for Texans: home, condo, renters, auto, motorcycle, life, umbrella, and a wide range of business policies. We also handle Texas-specific needs like coastal wind/hail, farm & ranch, and flood insurance through both private markets and national programs.

faqs.q: What makes your agency different in Texas?
faqs.a: We're independent, local, and Texas-focused. That means honest guidance, personal service, and access to many A-rated carriers that know the Texas market - from hail and hurricane exposure to rural and coastal needs - so we can tailor coverage that truly fits your life or business.

faqs.q: How quickly can I get a Texas quote or start coverage?
faqs.a: Most quotes are same-day, and many policies can start within 24 hours once we have your details. Auto can often be bound the same day, while homes may require quick underwriting checks (and, in some areas, an exterior inspection). We'll guide you each step.

faqs.q: Can I switch my insurance to you from another Texas provider?
faqs.a: Yes. We'll compare your current coverages, time the start date to avoid any lapse, and handle the transition and any necessary cancellations for a smooth switch.

faqs.q: Do you offer virtual or in-person appointments in Texas?
faqs.a: Yes. We meet by phone or video anywhere in Texas, and we're happy to meet in person locally by appointment.

faqs.q: How do I get a quote?
faqs.a: You can request a quote by calling our office, filling out our online form, or visiting us in person. We'll gather some basic information and provide you with a personalized quote - often in just a few minutes.

faqs.q: What information do I need to get started?
faqs.a: For a quote, you'll typically need basic details like your address, type of property or vehicle, current coverage (if any), and information about household members or drivers. We'll walk you through everything needed.

faqs.q: What should I do after an accident or claim situation?
faqs.a: Your safety comes first. Make sure everyone is safe, then contact emergency services if needed. As soon as possible, contact our agency so we can guide you through the claims process and help you every step of the way.

faqs.q: How do I make changes to my policy?
faqs.a: You can call or email our office to request changes, such as updating drivers, vehicles, or coverage amounts. We make policy changes quick and easy.

faqs.q: How can I lower my insurance premiums?
faqs.a: There are several ways to lower your premiums, such as bundling policies, increasing your deductible, maintaining a good driving record, installing safety devices, and qualifying for loyalty or claims-free discounts. We'll review your options with you.

faqs.q: Do you offer coverage for rental properties or vacation homes?
faqs.a: Absolutely. We offer landlord insurance for rental properties and specialized coverage for vacation or secondary homes. Let us know your situation and we'll find the right policy for you.

faqs.q: Why should I use a local insurance agency?
faqs.a: A local agency offers personal service, expert advice, and a relationship you can count on. We're here to answer your questions, advocate for you, and support you when you need us most.
